facts: Terra is a public blockchain protocol that deploys a suite of algorithmic decentralized stablecoins.
The network is built on the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint Consensus.
Terraform Labs secured $150 million from investors committed to deploying funds in the ecosystem.
Do Kwon serves as the CEO of Terraform Labs.
Matt Cantieri joined Terraform Labs as the General Manager of Anchor Protocol after previously working as Crypto Lead at Microsoft’s M12.
LUNA acts as Terra’s decentralized reserve asset where more demand for Terra stablecoins results in more value capture.
